comment: Crash signatures the loader campaign accepts, derived with obe_campaign.py --replay from the 19 crashing images of the 30,000-mutant run below. Each entry: the faulting function (interpreter frame under --jit=off; '(jit code)' for generated code), the assessment's class numbers, a reason, and the witness mutants. Update when the Nil-receiver trap fix (class 1) or the verifier class-rule change (CLASS_RULES) lands: remove the entries that no longer appear (a run reports them as 'not seen').

entries.reason: Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 1: Nil receiver of a trap-bodied library method; fixed by the Nil-receiver trap checks (P1), remove this entry when that lands.

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 2 (a method's own instance used as an unrelated class; CLASS_RULES refuses these, P2) and class 3a/3b/3e/3f (field read through a reference whose class the image does not record; needs the declared-class format change).
Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 3a: store through a closure capture whose class the image does not record.

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 3b/3d: a cast applied to a number read through an object field or interface-typed parameter whose class the image does not record.

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 2 (String:Append on the StrBuilder itself, refused by CLASS_RULES) and class 4 (a new array left as the receiver of an instance method).

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 5: an Int[] element read through as an array (the assessment lists boxing_before_after under 3b; its measured fault site is this one).

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 6: an Int[] returned as String[][] and the compiled array index has no dimension check (JIT only).
Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 7: a word of a function-typed local loaded as an Int and used as a reference.

Residual crash of crafted .obe images, measured at ed24d1edb2 (docs: OBE_RESIDUAL_ASSESSMENT 2026-11-27). Class 8: the JIT compiles instructions no path reaches (null dereference while compiling; interpreter runs).
